text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Why is my heart beating so fast?! I've already run in tons of races before, so why can't I calm down?
choice_data_list: Your heart will be beating even faster once you're standing in the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You're right! After all, I'm definitely gonna fly the highest this time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm going to make your heart pound too, Trainer! ♪
